AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Valve Body)     AT-83

Valve Body

Upper Front Valve Body
Upper Rear Valve Body
Cooler Return Check Ball
Damping Ball
Gasket

♦ Non-reusable part

(Disassembly of Valve Body)

1. UNBOLT AND REMOVE DETENT SPRING

2. REMOVE MANUAL VALVE

3. TURN ASSEMBLY OVER AND REMOVE NINE BOLTS FROM UPPER FRONT VALVE BODY AND UPPER REAR VALVE BODY
